entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: State where the MME has no EMM context or the EMM context is marked as detached. The UE is detached in this state.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to attach to the network.

entities.name: Combined attach procedure
entities.description: Combined procedure initiated by UE for attachment.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure for updating tracking area information.

entities.name: Combined tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Combined procedure for tracking area updating.

entities.name: Detach procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to detach from the network.

entities.name: ISR not activated or deactivated
entities.description: Condition where Idle mode Signalling Reduction is not active or becomes deactivated during specific procedures.

entities.name: MME enters EMM-DEREGISTERED state
entities.description: System behavior where MME transitions to EMM-DEREGISTERED state after successful completion of certain procedures when ISR is not active.

relations.description: MME may answer to attach procedure when in EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
MME may answer to combined attach procedure when in EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
MME may answer to tracking area updating procedure when in EMM-DEREGISTERED state with detached EMM context.
MME may answer to combined tracking area updating procedure when in EMM-DEREGISTERED state with detached EMM context.
MME may answer to detach procedure when in EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
When ISR is not activated or deactivated during specific procedures, MME enters EMM-DEREGISTERED state after successful completion.
